title: Positive direct images of quasi-coherent tensor-sections sheaves vanish
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i:X.Opens\to X.Etale$ a continuous functor with $i\circ forget=X.restrictFunctor$. Let $T=i_*$ be continuous direct image [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], assumed additive. For every quasi-coherent $X$-module $F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] and $n\in\mathbb N$, $R^{n+1}T(F_{et})=0$, where $F_{et}$ is the associated tensor-sections abelian sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. No global cohomology comparison or natural equivalence is asserted.

source.place: Proposition Tag 03DW (descent-proposition-same-cohomology-quasi-coherent), part (2); etale-cohomology.tex, Theorem Tag 03P2 (etale-cohomology-theorem-zariski-fpqc-quasi-coherent); sites-cohomology.tex, Tags 03F3, 072W and 0733(1)

proof.text: Evaluate an injective resolution of the associated etale sheaf at an affine open object W. Cohomology over that object is the global cohomology of its localization on the small etale site of W. Tensor-pullback composition identifies the localized sheaf with the tensor-sections sheaf of F restricted to W. Quasi-coherent affine acyclicity makes this group zero in every positive degree. When working with large coefficients, the coefficient-lift resolution comparison identifies the same complexes before and after lifting, so this applies to the original coefficient universe as well. Every open is covered by affine opens; hence all positive object-cohomology sections are locally zero. Sheafification is zero and the sheafified-presheaf description gives zero positive higher direct images. This argument only proves vanishing of derived direct image, without constructing any global comparison equivalence.
